kpi.approvedHelp: Are ri taq poy xkimatzij ri Aj Ch'akoj pa tikirib'al ri juna'. Are ri tikirib'al rech ri xolb'al.
kpi.availableHelp: Are ri xolb'al k'o ruk'in ri q'ij xuquje' kanoq. Nïm o ti'j xpe pa ri tikirib'al rech ri yawab'il ri Tinamït.
kpi.committedHelp: Taq poy xb'an chik rech taq tzijonem, taq tzijob'äl o taq ch'akoj. Man xel ta wi pa ri taq pa'ijb'äl, xa xe' k'o wi ri rub'eyal.
kpi.paidHelp: Taq poy xel chik pa ri taq pa'ijb'äl rech ri Tinamït. Are ri xb'an chik ruk'in ri k'ak'a' q'ij.

dashboard.label: Tikirib'äl
dashboard.message: Pa wakami kilo jas xb'an rech ri taq poy pa ri Tinamït! Kilo ri taq ronojel xuquje' taq tz'ib'.

explorar.label: ¿Jas xb'an?
explorar.message: Tiq'ax jumek'al b'ix chi kilo ri rub'eyal ri ch'akoj pa ronojel k'ojlib'äl.

tabla.label: Ilb'äl ronojel
tabla.message: Xoj xuquje' xojon ronojel taq ch'akoj pa ri juna'.

fuente.title: ¿Jas rub'eyal ri taq poy?
fuente.helpMessage: Ri Tinamït kuya' taq poy pa k'ïy rub'eyal: ri rub'ixik taq retamab'äl (taq tzijonem, taq ajk'amib'äl), ri IVA Paz xb'an ri ajawarem, ri Aporte Constitucional (10% rech ri xolb'al ajawab'äl) xuquje' junab'ik taq ulew.

programas.title: Ch'akoj pa Taq K'ojlib'äl
programas.helpMessage: Ri k'ojlib'äl kukemow taq ch'akoj rech ri Tinamït: ja' k'isb'äl, tijonik, taq nimsanik, ajb'anom, etc. Tiq'ax chi k'ojlib'äl chi kilo jas taq b'anom xb'an rech ri taq poy.

chart.helpMessageSingle: Ri säq tz'ib' kuq'et ri taq poy k'o. Ri tz'ib' color kuq'et jas xb'an chik chi b'an. Rumal wi are' ki'kotäj, are k'o wi rub'eyal ri xolb'al.
chart.helpMessageMulti: Kub'ij jas taq poy k'o (säq) vs jas xb'an chik chi b'an (color). Ri taq b'aq'wachib'äl kuq'et ri rub'eyal: q'an=ti'j, q'eq'al=chuwi', q'eq=nïm.

drilldown.empty: Man k'o ta wi taq b'ix pa wakami.
drilldown.chartTitle: K'o rech vs Xb'an chik — rech ri {level}

budgetTable.helpLineMessage: Ri tz'ib' kuq'et ri rub'anikil ri ch'akoj: taq aqanik, taq ajb'anom, taq k'amow, taq oxe', etc. K'ïy taq tz'ib' k'o pa ri Tinamït pa ronojel k'ojlib'äl ch'akoj.
budgetTable.helpFundingMessage: Kuq'et jas rub'eyal ri taq poy rech ri ch'akoj: taq poy rech ri Tinamït, aporte ri ajawarem, IVA Paz o jub'a taq ulew.
budgetTable.helpApprovedMessage: Ri taq poy xkimatzij chi b'an pa ri tz'ib' pa tikirib'al ri juna'.
budgetTable.helpAvailableMessage: Xolb'al k'o rech pa ri tz'ib', ruk'in taq b'anatajinaq.
budgetTable.helpCommittedMessage: Taq poy xb'an chik rech taq tzijob'äl o taq ch'akoj. Man xel ta wi xa xe' k'o wi ri rub'eyal.
budgetTable.helpPaidMessage: Taq poy xel chik pa ri taq pa'ijb'äl rech ri Tinamït pa ri tz'ib'.
budgetTable.helpPctMessage: Rucholaj ri taq poy k'o xb'an chik chi b'an. Q'eq=nïm (>70%), q'an=chuwi', q'an ch'ich'=ti'j (<30%).
budgetTable.noResults: Man xetz'et ta wi taq tz'ib' ruk'in wakami xojonem.
